[[Category:Operating Systems]]
Scheduling algorithms determine what to be used by the CPU at what time.
==Sheculing criteria==

* CPU utilization
* throughput - number of processes that complete esecution per time unit

==Pre-emptive vs non-pre-emptive algorithms==
==Shortest job first==
Algorithm that always runs the job with the shortest remaining time
==Round Robin Scheduling==
Each process gets a time quantum. Really confusing

Used primarily for when each process constantly running is a thing that's valued. For example running a compiler and a web browser and a music player at the same time
